ImageDescription.value: This picture represents how a small nation can still be filled with incredibly culturally rich minds that adore their country. All these decorations specify different parts of culture from the Dominican Republic. It is done almost weeks before the independence day of said country (the day of independence is the 27th of February)

Artist.value: Maria Elena Gonzalez Guillermo
